title: Brain tumour DNAm-age: privacy-minimized public release v1.0.1
publication_status: blocked pending institutional source-data licence confirmation
description: Public source tables use study pseudonyms and privacy-minimized clinical variables. Exact chronological ages derived from clinical dates, exact clinical dates, clinical accession mappings, patient-level survival times and vital status, raw patient sequencing data and detailed patient-level matrices are not included in the public release. Access to restricted patient-level data requires appropriate ethics approval and an executed Data Transfer Agreement (DTA) with the Medical University of Innsbruck.
